+"""Popup login returns an embedded app to its pending protected action."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Generator
+
+import pytest
+from auth_harness import AuthPluginHarness, authorize_as, base_url
+from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect
+from reflex.testing import AppHarness
+
+
+def IframeAuthApp():
+    """Public embedded page with a protected action and observable replay count."""
+    import reflex as rx
+
+    import reflex_enterprise as rxe
+    from reflex_enterprise.auth import AuthUserState
+    from reflex_enterprise.auth.oidc.state import GenericOIDCAuthState
+
+    class ProfileState(rx.State):
+        message: str = "initial"
+        reveals: int = 0
+
+        @rxe.event
+        async def reveal(self):
+            user = await AuthUserState.current() or {}
+            self.message = "revealed-" + str(user.get("sub"))
+            self.reveals += 1
+
+    @rxe.page(route="/", auth=False)
+    def index() -> rx.Component:
+        return rx.vstack(
+            GenericOIDCAuthState.get_login_button(),
+            rx.text(
+                rx.cond(GenericOIDCAuthState.has_any_token, "ready", "waiting"),
+                id="has-token",
+            ),
+            rx.text(ProfileState.message, id="message"),
+            rx.text(ProfileState.reveals, id="reveals"),
+            rx.button(
+                "Reveal",
+                on_click=ProfileState.reveal,
+                disabled=rx.cond(rx.State.is_hydrated, False, True),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    @rxe.page(route="/iframe", auth=False)
+    def iframe() -> rx.Component:
+        return rx.el.iframe(src="/", width="100%", height="700px")
+
+    app = rxe.App()
+    assert app
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(
+    scope="module",
+    params=[([], False), ([], True), (["offline_access"], False)],
+    ids=["default", "cookies-before-message", "refresh"],
+)
+def iframe_auth_app(
+    tmp_path_factory, mock_idp: str, request
+) -> Generator[tuple[AppHarness, bool], None, None]:
+    """Exercise popup login with and without an IdP-issued refresh token."""
+    from reflex_enterprise.auth.cookie import HTTPCookie
+
+    scopes, sync_first = request.param
+
+    class IframeAuthHarness(AuthPluginHarness):
+        rxconfig_template = """
+import reflex_enterprise as rxe
+
+
+def login_page(**context):
+    import reflex as rx
+    from reflex_enterprise.auth.pages import default_login_page
+    from reflex_enterprise.auth.oidc.state import GenericOIDCAuthState
+
+    return rx.vstack(
+        default_login_page(**context),
+        rx.text(
+            rx.cond(GenericOIDCAuthState.has_any_token, "ready", "waiting"),
+            id="has-token",
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+config = rxe.Config(
+    app_name="{app_name}",
+    plugins=[rxe.AuthPlugin(extra_scopes=SCOPES, login_page=login_page)],
+)
+""".replace("SCOPES", repr(scopes))
+
+    # Each parameter creates a new backend; cookie handlers must register on
+    # that app rather than retaining the previous harness's registration flag.
+    HTTPCookie._has_registered_handlers = False
+    try:
+        with IframeAuthHarness.create(
+            root=tmp_path_factory.mktemp("iframe_auth_app"), app_source=IframeAuthApp
+        ) as harness:
+            yield harness, sync_first
+    finally:
+        HTTPCookie._has_registered_handlers = False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pending", [True, False], ids=["pending-replay", "direct-login"]
+)
+def test_iframe_popup_login_returns_to_originating_page(
+    iframe_auth_app: tuple[AppHarness, bool], page: Page, pending: bool
+):
+    """The child returns automatically; a saved action runs exactly once."""
+    harness, sync_first = iframe_auth_app
+    frontend = base_url(harness)
+    if sync_first:
+        # Hold the real handoff until the opener adopts the popup's shared
+        # cookies. This pins the ordering that used to skip return navigation.
+        page.add_init_script("""
+            window.heldAuthMessage = null;
+            window.authMessageReleased = false;
+            addEventListener('message', event => {
+                if (event.data?.type === 'post_auth_generic' &&
+                    !window.authMessageReleased) {
+                    window.heldAuthMessage = {origin: event.origin, data: event.data};
+                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
+                }
+            });
+        """)
+    page.goto(frontend + "/iframe")
+    frame = page.frame_locator("iframe")
+    if pending:
+        frame.get_by_role("button", name="Reveal", exact=True).click()
+        expect(frame.get_by_role("heading", name="Sign in")).to_be_visible()
+        child = next(child for child in page.frames if child.parent_frame)
+        assert child.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('rxe_auth_pending_event')")
+
+    with page.expect_popup() as opened:
+        frame.get_by_role("button", name="Login with Generic", exact=True).click()
+    popup = opened.value
+    with popup.expect_event("close"):
+        authorize_as(popup, "alice")
+
+    if sync_first:
+        expect(frame.locator("#has-token")).to_have_text("ready")
+        child = next(child for child in page.frames if child.parent_frame)
+        child.wait_for_function("window.heldAuthMessage !== null")
+        child.evaluate("""() => {
+            window.authMessageReleased = true;
+            dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message', window.heldAuthMessage));
+            window.heldAuthMessage = null;
+        }""")
+
+    if not pending:
+        frame.get_by_role("button", name="Reveal", exact=True).click()
+    expect(frame.locator("#message")).to_have_text("revealed-alice", timeout=10000)
+    expect(frame.locator("#reveals")).to_have_text("1")
+    child = next(child for child in page.frames if child.parent_frame)
+    assert child.url == frontend + "/"
+    assert page.url == frontend + "/iframe"
+    assert not child.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('rxe_auth_pending_event')")

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+async def test_matching_popup_tokens_still_redirect_the_opener(
+    routed_state,
+    fake_client,
+    signing_key,
+    monkeypatch,
+    redirect_path,
+    refresh_token,
+    target,
+    expected,
+):
+    """Cookie sync can beat postMessage without completing the login redirect."""
+    state = routed_state
+    state.redirect_to_url = target
+    state._access_token_data = access_token_data()
+    state._id_token = make_id_token(signing_key)
+    state._refresh_token = refresh_token
+    state._granted_scopes = "openid email profile"
+    set_tokens = AsyncMock()
+    sync_tokens = Mock()
+    audit = AsyncMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(UserinfoAuthState, "_set_tokens", set_tokens)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(UserinfoAuthState, "_cookie_sync_token_update", sync_tokens)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(UserinfoAuthState, "_audit", audit)
+
+    result = await state.on_iframe_auth_success(
+        {
+            "data": {
+                "type": "post_auth_test_userinfo",
+                **await state._post_auth_message_payload(),
+            }
+        }
+    )
+
+    assert redirect_path(result) == expected
+    set_tokens.assert_not_awaited()
+    sync_tokens.assert_not_called()
+    audit.assert_not_awaited()
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("token_state", ["anonymous", "expired", "invalid"])
+async def test_matching_popup_tokens_do_not_redirect_without_valid_login(
+    state,
+    fake_client,
+    signing_key,
+    token_state,
+):
+    """An empty or rejected duplicate handoff must not complete a login."""
+    state.redirect_to_url = "/report"
+    if token_state != "anonymous":
+        state._access_token_data = access_token_data()
+        state._id_token = (
+            make_id_token(signing_key, exp_offset=-60)
+            if token_state == "expired"
+            else "invalid-id-token"
+        )
+
+    result = await state.on_iframe_auth_success(
+        {
+            "data": {
+                "type": "post_auth_test_userinfo",
+                **await state._post_auth_message_payload(),
+            }
+        }
+    )

+    assert result is None
